youtube_title: Burping And Gas After Every Meal? It's How Fast You Eat | Body Fix #41 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #41. Whole thali gone in 4 minutes... then burp after BURP?
B is right. Eat SLOWER, chew with your mouth closed. Fast eating = swallowing air.
Gulping, talking while chewing, straws and fizzy drinks: all air in your gut.
Fix: Chew slowly, fewer fizzy drinks and straws, short walk after.
Red flags: Pain, trouble swallowing, weight loss, vomiting or black stool? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Burping / swallowed air
